metadata.title: आदिवासियों के सामने झुकी सरकार | Tribal protest forced Tripura government to roll back decision
metadata.description: Students associated with the main opposition party, Tipra Motha, in Tripura organised a day-long bandh on February 12. They blocked highways and railway lines to protest the imposition of the Bengali script for Kokborok, the indigenous language. The opposition leader in the Tripura assembly visited the blocked sites to meet with the protesting students. Following the demonstrations, the state government announced in the evening that the Bengali script would not be mandatory, granting students the option to use the Roman script for Kokborok.
